problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a comprehensive tour for a specialized technician to service six distinct manufacturing plants.

The travel times between plants are recorded in minutes:
* Plant Alpha to Plant Beta: 209.8 minutes
* Plant Alpha to Plant Gamma: 109.1 minutes
* Plant Alpha to Plant Delta: 23.4 minutes
* Plant Alpha to Plant Epsilon: 107.3 minutes
* Plant Alpha to Plant Zeta: 97.2 minutes
* Plant Beta to Plant Gamma: 198.4 minutes
* Plant Beta to Plant Delta: 214.1 minutes
* Plant Beta to Plant Epsilon: 118.8 minutes
* Plant Beta to Plant Zeta: 216.8 minutes
* Plant Gamma to Plant Delta: 89.3 minutes
* Plant Gamma to Plant Epsilon: 155.6 minutes
* Plant Gamma to Plant Zeta: 24.7 minutes
* Plant Delta to Plant Epsilon: 120.9 minutes
* Plant Delta to Plant Zeta: 75.1 minutes
* Plant Epsilon to Plant Zeta: 161.3 minutes

The objective is to determine the minimal-duration circuit that allows the technician to perform an initial inspection at each facility precisely one time before concluding the tour back at the origin point.
